author: gemini-antigravity
scope: Coupled staggered PDAS re-equilibration execution on non-coarsened C6 mesh (15,252 CPE4 quads, 15,559 physical nodes) at target uy = 0.0018703125 mm with two-phase safeguarded relaxation: Stage 1 maintains conservative damping omega_d = 0.5 until active-set membership stabilizes (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations); Stage 2 activates candidate relaxation omega_d = 0.85 with automatic rollback if delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k; node-resolved active-set membership telemetry; preserving zero healing, signed KKT, and force/energy discrepancy <= 2.0%.
scientific_hypothesis: Package 171-R6 demonstrated that uniform damping omega_d = 0.5 effectively suppresses oscillatory divergence (active set contracted by 98.84% to 160 nodes), but encounters an empirical contraction plateau (rho ~ 0.9892, delta_d = 8.31e-3, shedding 8.7 nodes/iter) requiring >700 iterations. Under the falsifiable numerical hypothesis, active-set boundary shifting governs the plateau. Transitioning to safeguarded relaxation omega_d = 0.85 only after active-set membership stabilizes (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations), coupled with a 5% residual growth rollback safeguard and strict bounds [d0, 1.0], accelerates convergence toward delta_d <= 1e-5 while preserving coupled equilibrium, KKT stationarity, and physical non-healing.

mathematical_formulation.mesh_level: C6 (15,252 CPE4 elements, 15,559 physical nodes + RP 999999, 59 duplicate seam-slit pairs)
mathematical_formulation.damping_formulation: Two-phase: Stage 1 omega_d = 0.5; Stage 2 candidate omega_d = 0.85 activated upon active-set membership stabilization (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations)
mathematical_formulation.rollback_criterion: If delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k in Stage 2, trial update is reverted to omega_d = 0.5 state and Stage 1 resumes
mathematical_formulation.membership_telemetry: Explicit node-resolved active-set symmetric difference |Delta A_k| = |A_k \ A_{k-1}| + |A_{k-1} \ A_k| recorded in telemetry, distinct from scalar cardinalities |A_k|
mathematical_formulation.kkt_evaluation: Explicit post-relaxation KKT stationarity recomputation: solver.kkt(d^{k+1}, tau_active=1e-6, tau_free=1e-6) evaluated under corresponding H^{k+1}
mathematical_formulation.coupled_field_consistency: Final mechanical subproblem resolution on converged damage state to ensure u, d, H, RF, and energies refer to a mutually equilibrated state with delta_u <= 1e-9 mm and delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa
mathematical_formulation.phase_decoding: Strict fail-closed validation of exactly 15,559 unique physical-node records. Only documented 1-component damage or >=3-component U with damage in U3 accepted; 2-component (U1, U2), mixed counts, missing nodes, duplicate nodes, and nonfinite values rejected before clipping to d0
mathematical_formulation.obstacle_enforcement: Pointwise active-set Dirichlet clamp prescribed = {n: d0[n] for n in active} ensuring min(d - d0) >= -1.0e-6

source_differences: Package 171-R7 introduces two-phase safeguarded relaxation and active-set membership telemetry: (1) Replaces static uniform damping omega_d = 0.5 with a two-phase controller: Phase 1 maintains conservative damping omega_d = 0.5 during initial active-set contraction; Phase 2 activates candidate relaxation omega_d = 0.85 once active-set membership stabilizes; (2) Implements node-resolved active-set membership tracking measuring symmetric difference |Delta A_k| = |A_k \ A_{k-1}| + |A_{k-1} \ A_k|, requiring |Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations before transition, preventing premature acceleration during boundary shifting; (3) Adds residual growth rollback safeguard: if delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k in Phase 2, the trial state is reverted to omega_d = 0.5 damping; (4) Distinguishes scalar cardinality stability from true node membership stability in telemetry logging; (5) Retains all verified R6 fail-closed phase-field decoding logic (exactly 15,559 physical nodes, strict U3 extraction, rejection of 2-component/mixed output); (6) Retains all verified R5/R6 mechanical subproblem resolution, GP history loading (61,008 points), element-level SOLUTION serialization, and extractor CLI contracts; (7) Preserves strict acceptance criteria: delta_d <= 1e-5, delta_u <= 1e-9 mm, delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa, post-relaxation KKT <= 1e-6, zero healing, force and energy drift <= 2.0%, and frozen UEL CE8D5EDCD2911DCB018BB15275271F874E7EA62B8FB48CF4A8297469A83ACDD6.
